title: BMA Guidance Note: Management of Climate Change Risks for Commercial Insurers (March 2023)
citation: Bermuda Monetary Authority, Guidance Note, March 2023 (issued under the Insurance Act 1978 supervisory framework)
evidence: The note has no commencement clause. Cover reads "March 2023"; the BMA file path carries the upload stamp 2023-03-09 and the PDF's creation date is 9 March 2023 (opened 2026-11-10, sha256 d6ea91edfa4f3d1da3bed3f805a17a72360c0f39e8184679862ca2179a55d63e). Para 7: "insurers will be expected to provide in their relevant year-end Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA), Commercial Insurer’s Solvency Self-Assessment (CISSA), starting with their year-end 2022 ORSA/CISSA, on a best effort basis"; "the framework and measures are to be adopted and fully operational on or before year-end 2025."
notes: Guidance, written as supervisory expectations ("expects", "should"); the CISSA it points to is a statutory filing (para 46) but the note itself is not an Act or regulation. Date is the upload/creation date, not a printed day. Applies to commercial insurers (classes 3A, 3B, 4, C, D, E) and insurance groups. Row BM-BMA-ADOPTED is permission requested (website terms allow personal use only), so no text is stored.

title: Consumer Protection Act 1999 (1999 : 45), Part III unfair business practices, ss.11-12
evidence: Consolidated PDF opened 2026-11-10 (sha256 4707c3eafad6f58115a4eeac052a6fea8857aa973f97ffeef067e1928afbc96f) closes with "[Assent Date: 22 December 1999]" and "[Operative Date: 1 October 2000]". s.36: "This Act or any provision thereof comes into operation on such day as the Minister may appoint by notice published in the Gazette." s.11(1)(a): "a false, misleading or deceptive consumer representation" is deemed an unfair business practice; s.12(1): "No person shall engage in an unfair business practice."
notes: General consumer-law rule that reaches environmental claims in consumer sales; it names no environmental claim. The Gazette notice appointing the operative date was not separately opened; the date is the one the official consolidation prints. Row BM-LAWS-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (Crown copyright, all rights reserved; Copyright and Designs Act 2004 s.199 gives the Crown copyright in every Act and no exception covers republication), so no text is stored.
